{{about|the surname}}
'''Schaefer''' is an alternative spelling and [[cognate]] for the [[German language|German word]] [[Wikt:Schäfer|''schäfer'']], meaning [[Wikt:shepherd|'shepherd']],<ref>{{Citation
 |last=Morten |first=Oren Frederic |last2=Cole |first2=J.R. |year=1914
 |title=A History of Preston County, West Virginia, Part 1
 |chapter=III. The Old Frontier and the American Highlander |volume=1 |publisher=[[The Journal Publishing Company]]
 |place=[[Kingwood, West Virginia]] |page=312 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=hBIwAAAAYAAJ
 |accessdate=14 August 2011 |format=Google eBook }}</ref> which itself descends from the [[Old High German]] ''[[Wikt:scāphare|scāphare]]''. Variants "Shaefer", "Schäfer" (a standardized spelling in many German-speaking countries after 1880), the additional alternative spelling "Schäffer", and the [[Anglicisation|anglicised]] forms "Schaeffer", "Schaffer", "Shaffer", "Shafer", and "Schafer" are all common [[surname]]s.
{{tocright}}
